PROGRAM-ID. program-identification-entry, then optional AUTHOR, INSTALLATION, DATE-WRITTEN, DATE-COMPILED and SECURITY paragraphs of comment-entries. §2023:11.2.1 has "[ IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. ]" (header optional) followed by one id paragraph and [ options-paragraph ], and §2023:10.6.1 restates the same for a program-definition; §2023:11.10.2 keeps PROGRAM-ID. program-name-1. No 2023 rule carries AUTHOR, INSTALLATION, DATE-WRITTEN, DATE-COMPILED or SECURITY (the paragraph names do not occur in the 2023 text), so a 1985 program using them is refused under 2023, while a program without the header is newly accepted.
